title: Grateful Dead Live at Red Rocks Amphitheatre on 1982-07-27
source: Source Info: Dan Healy's Master Soundboard Cassettes (Sony TC-D5M/TDK MA-R90/Dolby B)> Frank Streeter's 1st generation 1/4 track Reels @ 3.75 ips (Sony TC770/Maxell UD35-90B)> Tim Dalton's PCM (Sony SLHF400/Sony HG betamax tape); Transfer Info: PCM (Sony SL-10)> Sony PCM-601ESD > Behringer Ultramatch Pro > Tascam DA-3000 (wav 16-bit/44.1k)> Adobe Audition 3.0 > TLH flac16

ai_review.summary: Energetic Red Rocks show with a strong Phil zone and Jerry’s left‑stage presence, but the recording suffers from uneven mix levels.
ai_review.review: Fans recall this as a high‑energy Red Rocks performance where Phil’s bass drove the band and Jerry’s playing on the left side stood out. The soundboard source is usable, yet reviewers note noticeably uneven levels and PA/technical issues that detract from the listening experience.

ai_rating.rationale: The show receives strong praise (high energy, standout performances) while the recording quality is marked as uneven, resulting in a moderate overall rating.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Mix/level and PA issues throughout; levels are noticeably uneven despite being an improvement over earlier SBD releases.

show_quality.setlist_flow: No specific setlist comments, but the concert is described as a memorable first Red Rocks experience with strong momentum.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Mentioned for his “crazy screaming” presence on the left side and being a major focus of the reviewer’s attention.
band_member_comments.Phil: Described as the driving force behind the band, with his bass work and vocals highlighted as peak moments.
